name: manxome-armoire-ciel-bonus-banish-swaps-an-omen-for-a-card-from-hand
notes: [Ciel Bonus] Banish Manxome Armoire: return one of your omens to hand, then banish a card from hand with an omen counter on it.

rulesClauses: [Ciel Bonus] Banish Manxome Armoire: Return one of your omens to your hand. If you do, banish a card from your hand and put an omen counter on it.
